analyzed_vuln.description: Container overflow in CIP ranking refinement: iterateCIPRanks() initializes each cipEntries[i] with only 1 element when seedWithInvars=true (or 2 when false), but later unconditionally writes cipEntries[i][numIts+1] each loop iteration. For molecules requiring many refinement iterations, numIts+1 can exceed current vector size/capacity assumptions (only reserve(16) is done), causing out-of-bounds write at line ~969.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: PoV is deserialized via MolPickler::molFromPickle(), which calls MolOps::assignStereochemistry() for old pickle versions, reaching assignAtomCIPRanks()->iterateCIPRanks(). A crafted molecule topology from pickle input drives repeated CIP iterations (numRanks<numAtoms across many rounds), so numIts grows until cipEntries[i][numIts+1] indexes past the actual vector size, triggering ASan container-overflow.
